scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('server/dist/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'server/dist/public', {recursive:true});}catch(e){}"
